explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/579: Erdős, Hajnal, Sós and Szemerédi 'could prove this is true for δ > 1/8'. The Lean statement is erdos_579 restricted to δ > 1/8: ∃ c > 0 such that for all large n every octahedron-free G on n vertices with at least δn² edges has an independent set of size ≥ cn. Faithful.
